My new hobby is learning about micrcontrollers. 

I recently bought a Pico 2W and a Pi Debug Probe to help learn C and the basics of electronic engineering. 
It's fun to be creative and I learn best with hands on tasks which makes these two skills a great pair. 

Right now I'm starting with extreme basics learning how to blink the onboard LED (it's tied to the wifi chip) and it requires me to extensively read the C SDK documentation to learn function calls.

#C #Programming #Electronics #Raspberrypi
